title: 'Fun Center' in Mall
content: On multiple occasions, I've seen a "Fun Center" on the first floor of the mall. It's a huge business that takes up a significant chunk of space, but I've never been inside because for some reason it's always closed in my dreams and the lights are almost always off. I put my face to the windows once and the inside looked like a combination of a massive arcade, a trampoline park, and a floor area that was either a dance floor or a roller rink.
